definitions.footballContextComparison: Exclude only perception ring-buffer layout. Compare full recorded body/support, controller/belief, RNG, current hand-joint state, ball, events, intents, penalties and game outcome state.
definitions.naturalOffenseEndAdvance: Natural uncensored offense-possession endpoint x minus suppliedLOS40. A field-advance measurement, not buildResult yards or a game efficiency rate. Live censors and defensive possession have null advance.
definitions.explosiveMeasurement: 20+yd natural offense field advance following a completion; all completion/live/turnover endpoints retained separately. No credit for a still-live completion.
definitions.pressureFlag: Existing engine pressured flag copied as-is. This panel does not independently establish pressure or validate its NFL incidence.
definitions.forceAccounting: Underlying physics unchanged. Current support loads/hand state and all body/controller/RNG states retained; this collector does not record substep force/work invariants and makes no new force-accounting claim.
definitions.decisions: Only fresh decisions with real cap queries are retained; cached repeats or decisions with no cap queries are not counted as new fresh records. Added/removed retained records can reflect new cap queries during an unchanged decision; matched choice changes are reported separately.

limits: Fixed ordinary pass panel is a paired mechanics guard, not NFL-rate calibration or an unbiased league sample. Two artificial rosters/calls atLOS40, no situational playcalling.
Every pair and adverse change is retained. Natural gain comparisons are unavailable when either endpoint is live-censored or defensive possession; no imputation.
The6yd maximum cap distance remains unchanged. The new early-primary safeguard tests the observed own vertical stem only and does not establish a physically reliable general roof-capability model.
Sampled pose and exact consumed receiver motion remain distinct from hidden current support/jobs/targets. Hidden state is diagnostic evidence only.
Short-cushion counts contain repeated queries. They are not errors or independent plays; simple straight-line projection does not prove a cap physically cannot hold.
